M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
**Workbench storage tower built and verified.** Brief requested a two-storey workbench tower with at least two drawers — delivered as a stacked half-hex column.

**Build:** `piece:0,0,0;half-n` at level 0 + `piece:0,0,1;half-n` at level 1 (snap joined vertically) with `drawer:0#0,0#cut` and `drawer:1#0,0#cut` on the cut faces (south side), all open faces capped with solid end caps. `check_build: ok:true, meshClash:clear, no issues`.

Props attempted for workshop dressing (fill_compartments with hexkey-set, pliers, screwdriver etc.) were refused as `PROP_NO_REST` — the drawer compartments overlap the cell wall/drawer mesh in this half-base configuration, so no workshop props currently rest inside. Leaving drawers empty keeps the verification clean; tools can still be stored by the user.

Visual: Look from front-south shows two stacked drawers forming a compact workbench tower.
